ADBuddy classifies every adb command, journals every change so it can be undone,
and asks before anything irreversible.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failure (see the error code)
  2    invalid usage
  75   temporary failure, retrying may help
  78   configuration error
  130  interrupted (Ctrl+C)

Usage:
  adbuddy [flags]
  adbuddy [command]

Examples:
  adbuddy setup    pair your phone and prepare the agent (once)
  adbuddy serve    start the host and the agent

Getting started:
  doctor        Check everything ADBuddy needs and say how to fix it
  serve         Run the ADBuddy host: live journal and confirmations
  setup         Set up ADBuddy: adb, phone pairing and agent environment

Day to day:
  attach        Connect this terminal to the agent (Ctrl+] detaches)
  connect       Connect to the phone by IP address and port
  env           Manage the agent environment
  journal       Show the journal of adb commands and their inverses
  new           Start a new conversation, with another agent if given
  remote        Open or close adb's network port 5555 (remote mode)
  run           Start a coding agent in the ADBuddy environment
  stop          Stop the agent that adbuddy serve runs (serve keeps running)
  undo          Undo journaled changes by running their inverses
  version       Print the ADBuddy version
  yolo          Turn the agent's YOLO mode off, or see whether it is on

For the agent:
  foreground    Show the app and activity in the phone's foreground
  notifications List the phone's current notifications
  screen        List what is on the phone's screen and where to tap
  screenshot    Save a screenshot of the phone, scaled down
  send          Send a file to the user's phone (for the agent)
  tap           Tap a screen element by text, id or point
  type          Type text in the phone's focused field

Additional Commands:
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help          Help about any command

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for adbuddy
      --json      machine-readable JSON output, for the commands that support it
  -v, --version   version for adbuddy

Use "adbuddy [command] --help" for more information about a command.
